arabic text: BOLAY PADAR SAY AKBAR BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: Akbar said to his father: do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: HAI JAAN UB LABON PER BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: My life has reached my lips—do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: BABA NAZAR KO PHAYR LO DUM TOOT NAY LAGA\nBARCHI KAY PHAL SAY KHOON HAI DIL KA RUKA HUA\nUBLAY GA KHOON ZAMEEN PER BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: Baba, turn your gaze away; my breath is breaking.\nThe spearhead has trapped my heart's blood.\nBlood will erupt upon the earth—do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: SAANSEYN UKHAR RAHI HAIN THO MADHAM HAI NABZ BHI\nKARTE HO AAHA HUMKO HAI THAKEED SABR KI\nKEHTAY HO THAAM KAY JIGAR, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: My breaths are failing and my pulse has weakened.\nYou command me to remain patient while giving me hope.\nHolding your heart, you say: do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: MAINEY TUMHAY BULAYA THA THAAKAY MEI KEH SAKOON\nBILKUL NA GHAM KARO MERE DIL KO HAI UB SUKOON\nBAITHAY RAHO YAHAN MAGAR, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: I called you only so that I could say:\ndo not grieve; my heart has now found peace.\nRemain seated here, but do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: BOLAY HUSSAIN BAAP KO BEHLARAHAY HAIN AAP\nMALOOM HAI YAHAN SAY KAHAN JA RAHAY HAIN AAP\nKEHTAY HO MOU KO PHAYR KER, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: Hussain said: you are trying to console your father.\nYou know where you are about to go from here.\nTurning your face away, you say: do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: AKBAR PUKARAY BAAP SAY DIL KO SAMBHALIYAI\nTUTI SINA KALAYJAY MEI REHNAY HEE DIJIYAI\nNIKLAY GA SAATH MEI JIGAR, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: Akbar called to his father: steady your heart.\nLeave the broken spear within my chest.\nMy liver will come out with it—do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: MOULA NAI YA ALI KAHA DIL KO SAMBHAL KER\nPHIR KHUD HEE LAR KHARAAGAEY BARCHI NIKAAL KER\nKEHTA RAHA JAVAN PISAR, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: The Maula said Ya Ali and steadied his heart;\nthen, after pulling the spear, he himself began to stagger.\nThe young son kept saying: do not pull out the spear.

arabic text: REHAN SAATH BARCHI KAI DIL BHI NIKAL PARA\nPARHTAY RAHAY HUSSAIN BHI, THAA DAYR MERSIA\nMAA KEHTI AAEE NANGAY SAR, BARCHI NA KHAINCHNA
english translation text: O Rehan, the heart came out together with the spear.\nHussain continued reciting the elegy for a long time,\nwhile the mother came bareheaded, crying: do not pull out the spear.
